"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The word \"climate\" appears in the current President's strategy more often than Al Qaeda, nuclear proliferation, radical Islam, or weapons of mass destruction.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The phrase \"global war on terror\" does not appear in the current President's strategy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration purposely avoided and changed the phrase \"global war on terror\" to \"overseas contingency operations\".",
